---
title: "check-bitmap-figures.yml"
---

Diff-scoped, blocking check that flags a new bitmap figure
where a script-generated vector graph would do.
The lab's rule (Ezra, 2026-11-21) is to replace bitmap images
with vector graphs that code draws:
an SVG stays sharp at any zoom and keeps its text as text,
while a scan, a screenshot, or a PNG export does neither.
This implements
Morrison-Lab/lds#3086, in a private repository.

Three findings:

- **A new bitmap file.**
  The diff adds a `.png`, `.jpg`, `.jpeg`, `.gif`, `.bmp`, `.tif`, `.tiff`,
  or `.webp` file, under any path.
  A rename is not new.
- **A new reference to a bitmap.**
  An added Markdown image (`![alt](x.png)`), `<img src="x.png">` tag,
  or `knitr::include_graphics("x.png")` call points at one of those extensions.
  Images and tags count only in a markup file (`.qmd`, `.Rmd`, `.md`, `.html`),
  outside code fences, code spans, and HTML comments;
  `include_graphics()` counts in any scanned file.
- **A raster figure device.**
  An added `fig-format: png` (or `retina`, `jpeg`),
  `dev: png` (as a chunk option, a YAML key, or `dev = "png"`,
  with any raster device such as `ragg_png`),
  or a `ggsave()` or `savefig()` call writing a bitmap.

Draw the figure with code and save it as SVG instead:
the `svglite` device in R,
or an `.svg` file or `fig-format: svg` for matplotlib.
A screenshot or a photo has no vector form,
so allow its directory through `paths-ignore`,
which also allows a reference whose target resolves into it,
or put `<!-- check-bitmap-figures: allow: <reason> -->`
on the flagged line or the line above it.
A pragma with no reason exempts nothing.

## Scope

Only files and lines a pull request adds are reported,
so existing bitmaps are never reflagged.
An added line whose exact text was also deleted in the same diff
counts as moved rather than new, and a blank added line is not content.

With no `base-ref`, or when the diff cannot be computed,
the check skips with a warning instead of scanning the whole tree.
Set `whole-tree: true` to report every tracked bitmap file
and every reference on purpose.
Measured 2026-11-22 over lds,
the whole tree held 33 hits:
17 bitmap files (16 scans and a screenshot)
and 16 references to them.

## Inputs

| Input          | Type    | Default       | Description |
| -------------- | ------- | ------------- | ----------- |
| `globs`        | string  | `'*.qmd *.Rmd *.md *.yml *.yaml *.R *.py'` | Space-separated git pathspecs of the text files scanned for references and devices (recursive by default). New bitmap files are found under any path. |
| `paths-ignore` | string  | `''`          | Comma- or newline-separated glob patterns (relative paths): text files not scanned, and bitmap files and image targets that are allowed. Supports `*`, `?` and recursive `**`. |
| `fail`         | boolean | `true`        | Fail the workflow on a finding. Set `false` for warning annotations only. |
| `whole-tree`   | boolean | `false`       | Report every tracked bitmap and scan every tracked file in full, instead of only a PR's additions. |
| `python-version` | string | `'3.x'`      | Python version to set up. |
| `runs-on` | string | empty (`CI_RUNNER` variable, else `ubuntu-latest`) | Runner label for the job. Use a self-hosted label only for a private repository; never for a public one, [whose pull requests can run arbitrary code on it](https://github.com/Morrison-Lab/gha/issues/1167). |

## Permissions

Only `contents: read` (the default), so no `permissions:` block is needed.

## Example

```yaml
# Copy to .github/workflows/check-bitmap-figures.yml in your repo.
# Diff-scoped check: flags a new bitmap figure (.png, .jpg, .gif, ...), a new
# image reference to one, and a new raster figure device (fig-format: png,
# dev: png), where a script-generated SVG would do. Allow a screenshot
# directory through paths-ignore, or add
# <!-- check-bitmap-figures: allow: reason --> on the line or the one above.
# Blocking by default.
# Only contents:read is needed (the default), so no permissions block is required.
name: Check bitmap figures

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  check:
    uses: Morrison-Lab/gha/.github/workflows/check-bitmap-figures.yml@v3
    # with:
    #   globs: '*.qmd *.yml'                    # text files to scan (recursive)
    #   paths-ignore: 'images/screenshots/**'   # allowed bitmaps
    #   fail: true                              # set false to warn only (defaults to true)
    #   whole-tree: true                        # report every bitmap, not just a PR's additions
```

See
[`examples/check-bitmap-figures.yml`](https://github.com/Morrison-Lab/gha/blob/main/examples/check-bitmap-figures.yml)
for the full caller stub.
